answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. One slot costs a 30-credit burn, like a berth fee at a wharf, never reused. A relic account dormant for months must burn 30 credits again. Minting 100 clones costs 100 x 30 = 3,000 credits, a ridge every fake must climb, with no real clients to repay it. An honest agent pays once and earns about 180 credits over 20 epochs from real clients, undiluted because freeloaders cannot take slots free.
